verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a REST API for programmatic, UI-free automation (e.g., POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts, batch custom-object retrieval) and an installable CLI (npm install -g @hubspot/cli && hs init), plus up to 10 test accounts for testing integrations. That covers headless automation in principle, but nothing in the pack documents running the CLI non-interactively in CI pipelines. The CLI flow shown is an interactive 'authorize your account' step. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/CI authentication (tokens or env vars for pipelines), CI pipeline guidance or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.
